about.title: Novato Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Defective products don't just cause harm on the road — they show up in garages along Novato Boulevard, kitchens near downtown, and job sites off San Marin Drive. Whether it's a malfunctioning power tool, a car part that failed on US-101, or a household item that caught fire, California law lets injured people pursue the manufacturer, distributor, or retailer without having to prove anyone was careless. That's the strict liability standard, and it can make these cases move differently than a typical crash claim. What matters most early on is preserving the product itself, since it often becomes the central piece of evidence. LawProactive doesn't practice law or handle your case directly — we simply connect Novato residents with an independent attorney who can review what happened and explain your options, at no upfront cost to you.

whyChoose.title: Why Novato Residents Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify Your Case
items.desc: California generally doesn't require proof of negligence in product cases — just that the product was defective and caused harm. An attorney can help identify whether the defect was in design, manufacturing, or warnings.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held accountable. A connected attorney can help sort out who was involved in getting the product into your hands.

items.title: Evidence Preservation Matters Early
items.desc: Since the product itself is often the key evidence, acting quickly to preserve it can protect your claim. We can connect you with someone who understands how to guide that process.

items.question: Do I need to prove the manufacturer was negligent?
items.answer: Not necessarily. Under California's strict liability framework, you generally need to show the product was defective and that it caused your injury, rather than proving carelessness. An independent attorney can evaluate the specifics of your situation and explain which theory fits best.

items.question: What should I do with the product that hurt me?
items.answer: Keep it in its current condition and avoid repairs or alterations if possible. The product is often the most important piece of evidence in these claims, so preserving it, along with packaging, receipts, or manuals, can matter a great deal.

items.question: Are product liability claims common in Novato?
items.answer: Novato sees its share of injury incidents tied to vehicles, tools, and consumer goods, much like other Marin County communities. While crash data for corridors like Redwood Boulevard and Novato Boulevard is tracked separately, defective product injuries can happen anywhere, from homes to job sites, and often go unreported publicly.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge anything upfront?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service that connects injured people with independent attorneys who work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless they recover compensation for you.
